subject.title: fix: copilot token cache ignores profile rotation on rate limit

question: Should maintainers ask the contributor to rebase and prove this PR, or adopt the fix in a fresh branch against the active provider-auth helper?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and the proposed direction is useful, but the PR is conflicting, patches obsolete paths, and lacks contributor-side real behavior proof that automation cannot supply.

options.title: Ask for rebase and proof
options.body: Have the contributor port the guard to `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`, update current tests, and add redacted real two-profile Copilot proof before merge.

options.title: Maintainer adopts the fix
options.body: A maintainer can open a narrow replacement PR against current main if this bug is urgent and the stale fork is unlikely to be refreshed.

options.title: Pause or close after no response
options.body: If no rebase or proof arrives after maintainer follow-up, close this PR while keeping the canonical issue open.

recommendation.title: Ask for rebase and proof
recommendation.body: Have the contributor port the guard to `src/plugin-sdk/provider-auth.ts`, update current tests, and add redacted real two-profile Copilot proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: `steipete` is the current live assignee and has provider-auth/Copilot helper history relevant to the port decision.
